intent: Count the reads of this coordinate-sorted single-end ChIP-seq alignment (H3K4me3_chip.bam, from Bowtie2) in each region of peaks.saf, counting PCR duplicates only once, i.e. every group of reads with identical start and strand contributes a single count.
silent_error: featureCounts --ignoreDup does not detect duplicates itself: it only skips reads whose SAM flag has the duplicate bit 0x400 ('Duplicate reads are identified using bit 0x400 in BAM/SAM FLAG field' in the usage text). The Bowtie2 BAM was never duplicate-marked, so no read carries the flag and nothing is skipped; the banner nevertheless says 'Duplicated Reads : ignored', the summary shows Unassigned_Duplicate 0, and the table has the normal layout (peak_A 15, peak_B 11, peak_C 7 instead of 9, 6, 7). The clean run first marks the duplicates with samtools markdup (coordinate-sorted input, single-end) and then counts.
